product_context.problem_statement: Recruiters face overwhelming candidate application volumes during hiring campaigns, leading to triaging bottlenecks, inconsistent candidate evaluation, and response delays.
product_context.value_hypothesis: AI-assisted resume qualification parsing and shortlist recommendation reduces screening cycle time by 40% while preserving recruiter decision ownership and candidate fairness.
product_context.user_journey_moment: After application submission and prior to first recruiter shortlist review
product_context.fallback_experience: Recruiters switch to manual chronological candidate review in the standard Applicant Tracking System when AI recommendation service is paused or unavailable.

system_profile.purpose: Screen applicant resumes and highlight qualification evidence to recommend an interview shortlist for recruiters.
system_profile.decision_impact: Directly influences candidate shortlist selection for interview advancement, impacting equal access to employment opportunities.
system_profile.deployment_context: Enterprise ATS cloud application integrated with vendor recommendation APIs deployed for employers in Southeast Asia and Europe.

system_boundary.model: Large language model parsing with deterministic eligibility rule evaluation
system_boundary.application: Web-based Applicant Tracking System recruiter review portal

industry_risk_snapshot.rationale: Employment screening decisions directly affect economic opportunity, livelihood, and personal dignity. Automated resume scoring at scale carries severe risk of perpetuating demographic bias and locking candidates out without transparent recourse. Enforcing human review and strict disparity monitoring is essential.

vietnam.rationale: As of 1 January 2026, the Law on Personal Data Protection No. 91/2025/QH15 is the applicable Vietnamese law governing personal data processing. It requires explicit consent before collecting and processing personal data, including automated profiling that influences employment decisions. It is uncertain whether the system's resume parsing and candidate ranking qualify as automated decision-making subject to additional obligations under the 2025 law. Implementing decrees are still being issued and enforcement precedents for AI-based hiring tools have not yet been established. Vietnamese legal and privacy counsel review is required before deployment.

eu.rationale: Under Annex III of the EU AI Act Regulation 2024/1689, AI systems used for recruitment and candidate screening are classified as High-Risk AI systems requiring strict risk governance.

legal_classification.other_markets: US EEOC guidelines require adverse impact auditing under Title VII.

product_metrics.success_kpi: Median recruiter screening time per candidate shortlist reduced by 40% within 60 days of pilot launch.
product_metrics.risk_kri: Candidate qualification recall gap between monitored demographic proxy groups remains below 5 percentage points.
product_metrics.guardrail_metric: Automatic candidate rejection count remains strictly zero across all production reporting periods.
product_metrics.review_cadence: Bi-weekly during pilot phase and triggered immediately upon any disparity threshold breach alert.

release_decision.risk_acceptance_owner: VP of Human Resources & Chief Compliance Officer
release_blockers: GAP-01: Disparity audit and non-discrimination verification under EU AI Act High-Risk requirement
release_conditions: Zero automated rejection paths configured in production ATS workflow
Signed independent demographic parity and bias audit report
Active candidate appeal mechanism and recruiter override protocol
release_decision.next_review_trigger: Triggered upon 500 candidate evaluations, any bias incident report, or on 2026-11-30.
release_decision.residual_risk_rationale: The system operates solely as a decision-support assistant with mandatory recruiter review for all final screening decisions. Auto-rejection is disabled, and continuous disparity metrics alert team to potential bias.
